title: Wildland Urban Interface (WUI) Firefighting
cross_references: Common Denominators of Fire Behavior on Tragedy Fires

nodes.text: Do not commit to stay and protect a structure unless a safety zone is identified

evidence.source_text: Do not commit to stay and protect a structure unless a safety zone for firefighters and equipment has been identified at the structure during sizeup and triage.

nodes.text: Move to the nearest safety zone, let the fire front pass, and return as soon as conditions allow

evidence.source_text: Move to the nearest safety zone, let the fire front pass, and return as soon as conditions allow.

nodes.text: Base all actions on current and expected fire behavior

evidence.source_text: Base all actions on current and expected fire behavior  do this first!

nodes.text: Estimate approaching fire intensity to determine safety zone adequacy

evidence.source_text: An estimate must be made of the approaching fire intensity in order to determine if there is an adequate safety zone and time available before the fire arrives.

nodes.text: Consider worst case fire behavior and build contingency actions

evidence.source_text: It is imperative that firefighters consider the worst case and build contingency actions into their plan to compensate for the unexpected.

nodes.text: Conduct Structure Sizeup considering site and tactical challenges
Defensible - Prep and Hold: Implement structure protection tactics during fire front contact
Defensible - Standalone: Patrol following fire front passage
Non-Defensible - Prep and Leave: Set trigger point for safe retreat
Non-Defensible - Rescue Drive-By: Check for people, set trigger point for safe retreat
Manage equipment and water use effectively
